label: Wall Panel Sensors
info:
Republishes chosen zigbee2mqtt sensor readings as wall-panel TILES.

  zigbee2mqtt/<device>  ->  wallpanel/tiles/sensors/<key>  (retained)

On import:
  1. Edit the SENSORS map at the top of the function node: your zigbee2mqtt
     friendly names, and only the readings worth a tile.
  2. Point both MQTT nodes at your existing authenticated broker config.
     That user must be allowed to publish wallpanel/tiles/#.

The panel shows them with tiles.html?board=sensors (the "sensors" view in
views.js). To remove a tile, publish an empty retained payload to its topic.
Contract: kiosk-display/docs/todo-view-mechanisms.md.
